_comment: STAGE 1 of the ISL-limit test. The ISL RELATIVE layer (multiAsset.twoWayISL) is OFF, so no crosslink shape solve runs at all. Purpose: confirm that the 'raw per-asset EKF' figure the beamforming diagnostic reports in the ON runs (232 MHz = 0.0646 m) is a genuine standalone result, i.e. that simply differencing the independent per-asset EKFs really does beat the 0.2953 m the crosslink solve produces. measurements.isl.* (ISL aiding INSIDE each per-asset EKF) is left untouched -- only the relative/shape solve is removed, so the per-asset filters are identical to the ON run.
_atmosphereTruth: Troposphere + ionosphere master enables, plus the three iono realism items realism grade does NOT set: 2nd-order dispersion, thin-shell obliquity, and phase scintillation on the TRUTH carrier.

errors._hardwareDelay: CALIBRATED BUT NOT ZERO. Realism grade sets sigma_m = 0.5 m, which is an UNcalibrated per-tower group delay. A flown system calibrates this; the honest residual is the calibration error, not the raw delay. 0.05 m = 167 ps residual after calibration. Note sigma_m is the STOCHASTIC RESIDUAL channel (injected only with residualStochastic.enable + truth.enable, both set by realism grade); truth.default_m is the separate deterministic term and stays 0.

_sharedAtmosphere: Satellites ~1.6 km apart must see essentially the SAME atmosphere. Independent per-satellite draws were a measured ARTEFACT (single-difference atmosphere 0.954 m -> exactly 0 once the streams are re-rooted on a formation-wide seed).

isl._noTwoWayTimeTransfer: MEASURED INCOMPATIBILITY, not an oversight. Enabling measurements.isl.twoWay.timeTransfer here dies 2.6 min in with 'No state block exists for spacecraft 2' at AssetStateBlock.forAsset:31 -- a federated leaf is a single-asset EKF with no block for its neighbour. The two uses of ISL are mutually exclusive; this scenario keeps ISL code+carrier IN the per-asset EKF, so the ISL relative CLOCK layer is off while the ISL two-way RANGE relative layer stays active via multiAsset.twoWayISL.

multiAsset._islSigma: REALISTIC-BUT-CONSERVATIVE Ka. sigma_m is the two-way thermal 1-sigma AT linkBudget.refDistance_m. masterConfig ships 0.01 m (cm-class wideband); the mm-ISL scenario used 0.001 m, which is an aspiration rather than a flown number. 0.05 m is a defensible conservative Ka figure and keeps the shape result honest. delayCal is CALIBRATED BUT NOT ZERO: 0.005 m const (17 ps residual turn-around + antenna-PCO) and 0.002 m random-walk, against masterConfig's uncalibrated 0.01/0.003.
multiAsset._beamLock: ARM B: beam-pointing lock OFF. Identical to arm A in every other respect, so the pair isolates exactly what the lock buys on the corrected R.

_deliberatelyOff.jointGeometry / groundDifferencedRotatio: MEASURED: both spend formation deformation to buy rotation (coherent frequency falls to 227/79 MHz). The beam-pointing lock supersedes them -- it reads orientation off the wavefront tilt without touching shape.
_deliberatelyOff.physics.sagnac.truth.enable: DOUBLE-COUNT: Sagnac is already subsumed by the geometric Earth rotation.
_deliberatelyOff.measurements.isl.doppler: DEGRADES at GEO -- the satellite is ~stationary in ECEF so range-rate is position-driven, not velocity-driven.
